title: Creamy Exotic Sevaiiya Noodle Soup
description: A rich and creamy soup blending the unique flavors of exotic and Brazilian ingredients, featuring sevaiiya noodles.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the sevaiiya noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the sliced exotic mushroom and cook until tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the Brazilian spices. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the soup has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked sevaiiya noodles to the soup and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
